Payment Dates  The Issuing Entity will make payments  on the Notes on the 15th day of each month, except that when the 15th day is not a business day, the Issuing  Entity will make payments on the Notes on the next business day. We refer to such date as a “Payment Date.” The  initial Payment Date will be August 17, 2026.  The Final Scheduled Payment Date for  each class of Notes is listed below. The Depositor expects that each class of Notes will be paid in full prior to its Final Scheduled  Payment Date.  Class  A-1 Notes August  16, 2027  Class A-2 Notes July 15, 2030  Class A-3 Notes May 17, 2032  Class B Notes June 15, 2032  Class C Notes January 17, 2034  Record Dates  So long as the Notes are in book-entry  form, the Issuing Entity will make payments on the Notes to the related holders of record on the day immediately preceding the related  Payment Date.
